entities.name: PMID:10751297
observations: Retrospective review of 176 ALIF patients identified 20 with painful discs within a radiographically solid prior posterolateral fusion; 18 had follow-up averaging 58 months.
Mean pain score improved from 7.9 to 4.7 (P<0.001), and Oswestry score improved from 56.3 to 47.9 (P=0.04).
All patients had radiographic solid anterior fusion; 16/18 were satisfied, and 5/15 previously unable to work returned to work.

entities.name: Revision ALIF series 2023
observations: Retrospective level-IV series of 22 revision ALIF patients followed for a mean of 73 months.
Back-pain MCID was achieved by 50%, leg-pain MCID by 64%, and 73% had excellent or good modified MacNab outcomes.
Two or more previously fused segments predicted poorer back-pain response; the cohort was not specific to isolated prior posterolateral fusion or discogenic pain.

entities.name: Salvage ALIF evidence limits
observations: No robust comparative trial or sizable dedicated cohort was identified for anterior salvage fusion of same-level pseudarthrosis after prior posterolateral-only fusion.
Direct evidence for adjacent-segment disease treated with ALIF was not established; adjacent-segment disease is distinct from same-level residual discogenic pain.
